_help: Copy this file to playlists.json and edit it for your SD card. Paths are folders on the card, relative to its root.
playlists: fixed playlists, name -> list of folders. "*" means every song; a trailing * matches folder-name prefixes.
per_folder: one playlist for every subfolder (artist, album, game...) that has at least min_tracks songs.
rename: text replacements applied to per_folder names, e.g. to drop " (Explicit)" or quality tags.
Start names with a digit and ". " ("1. Mix - ...") so they sort into groups; only those are ever replaced, so playlists you make in Molly Remote are kept.
